## Où j'en suis
The HubSpot owner + ARR sync was rebuilt as a 15-min polling job on `daniel/hubspot-owner-sync` (commits `8b3e6f1`, `2d90ac4`, `ae47c15`): windowed paging past the 10k search cap, `arr > 0` filter, no webhooks. PR #409 is open with auto-merge set, but blocked by a failing e2e test; #405 (webhooks) is closed.

- [en-cours] Fix e2e `test_accounts_table_shows_owner` in #409 (fixture has a trial company now filtered out; expected 3 rows, got 2) — not started yet.
- [prochaine-étape] Update the fixture (give the third company ARR > 0 or expect 2 rows), let auto-merge fire, then deploy.
- [prochaine-étape] Noa to move `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to AWS Secrets Manager for staging/prod.
- [essai-raté] Webhook subscriptions via API (curl, #405): 401 — private app tokens can't manage webhook subscriptions.
- [décision] Poll every 15 min instead of webhooks, close #405 (source: t04)
- [décision] Sync only companies with ARR > 0, skip trials entirely (source: t10)
